entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Hey, are you busy again today?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Don't you want to talk about[n]the Phantom Thieves?
entries.uk: Хіба ти не хочеш поговорити[n]про Фантомних Злодіїв?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'll be at the arcade in Akiba.[n]You should stop by if you can.
entries.uk: Я буду в аркадній залі в Акібі.[n]Заходь, якщо зможеш.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I guess you don't care about me...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Thanks for coming today. I look[n]forward to teaching you again.
entries.uk: Дякую, що сьогодні прийшов. Чекаю,[n]коли знову зможу тебе повчити.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So, what'll it be? Do you want to accept[n]Shinya's invitation?
